author: JerryRigEverything
description:
Not all robots are created equal. Waterproof robots reign supreme. Get a FREE solar powered iSkim ($499 value) when you buy a BeatBot Aquasense X HERE: https://qz-l.com/S7N-t9 (Official Website)  The Beatbot Aquasense X is able to operate autonomously  underwater for 5 hours at a time to clean a pool. Using AI it can diferentiate between 40 different objects, AND clean multiple platforms and steps underwater.  Today we are going to see how the BeatBot Aquasense X is built - so that our off road tracked wheelchairs can survive better in streams and beaches. 

Use code BBXJERRY for an extra 7% OFF 

You can also find the BeatBot Aquasense X on Amazon: https://qz-l.com/gB2PNo 

with more information here: https://qz-l.com/irLJDy

HUGE thanks to BeatBot for also supporting the wheelchair factory.  If you need a wheelchair - use code BEATBOT to get $500 dollar discount. https://www.NotaWheelchair.com
